## 🌐 Urdu (اردو) Documentation Translation — Review Tracker

This issue tracks the review progress for the complete Urdu documentation translation added in #15117.

### 📖 Preview the docs

👉 **[Preview Urdu Docs](https://d914cf26.fastapitiangolo.pages.dev/ur/)**

### 🤝 How to help review

This is a **collaborative review effort** — you don't need to review everything! Pick one or a few pages, review them, and check them off. This way the workload is distributed across multiple reviewers.

**Review guidelines:**
- Check the translation for accuracy and natural Urdu flow
- Ensure technical terms are kept in English (as per the [translation prompt](https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/blob/feat/urdu-docs-translation/docs/ur/llm-prompt.md))
- Verify code blocks and links are intact
- Comment on the PR with any corrections needed, referencing the file path
- Once a page looks good, check it off below
